title: Chemistry
description: ICSE Class X Chemistry: one theory paper of 2 hours carrying 80 marks (Section I 40 compulsory, Section II choose 4 of 6) plus 20 marks internal assessment of practical work.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ICSE Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Chemistry (www.cisce.org), corroborated by Oswal Publishers' 2026-27 reproduction.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. Units: Periodic Properties; Chemical Bonding; Acids, Bases and Salts; Analytical Chemistry; Mole Concept and Stoichiometry; Electrolysis; Metallurgy; Study of Compounds (HCl, Ammonia, Nitric acid, Sulphuric acid); Organic Chemistry.

sections.title: Chemistry
sections.description: Physical, inorganic and organic chemistry units.

chapters.title: Periodic Properties and Variations
chapters.blurb: Trends in atomic size, metallic character, ionisation potential, electron affinity and electronegativity up to period 3.

chapters.title: Chemical Bonding
chapters.blurb: Electrovalent, covalent and coordinate bonding with electron dot structures and characteristic properties.

chapters.title: Study of Acids, Bases and Salts
chapters.blurb: Ionisation, pH scale, types of salts and methods of preparation of normal salts.

chapters.title: Analytical Chemistry
chapters.blurb: Action of NaOH and NH4OH on salt solutions of Ca, Fe, Cu, Zn and Pb; recognition of gases.

chapters.title: Mole Concept and Stoichiometry
chapters.blurb: Gay-Lussac's law, Avogadro's law, mole concept, vapour density, percentage composition, empirical formula.

chapters.title: Electrolysis
chapters.blurb: Electrolytes, ionisation, preferential discharge, electrolysis of lead bromide, water and copper sulphate, electroplating.

chapters.title: Metallurgy
chapters.blurb: Occurrence of metals, concentration, calcination and roasting, reduction, refining and corrosion.

chapters.title: Study of Compounds: Hydrogen Chloride
chapters.blurb: Preparation, properties, fountain experiment, uses of hydrogen chloride and hydrochloric acid.

chapters.title: Study of Compounds: Ammonia
chapters.blurb: Preparation, properties, fountain experiment, oxidations and uses of ammonia.

chapters.title: Study of Compounds: Nitric Acid
chapters.blurb: Preparation, oxidising properties, reactions with copper and non-metals, uses.

chapters.title: Study of Compounds: Sulphuric Acid
chapters.blurb: Manufacture by contact process, properties as acid, oxidising and dehydrating agent, uses.

chapters.title: Organic Chemistry
chapters.blurb: Unique nature of carbon, homologous series, alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, alcohols and carboxylic acids; IUPAC nomenclature.
